parameters.query:
SELECT v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, v.tax_id, v.email, v.bank_account, v.status, v.approval_limit, $1::jsonb AS finance_payload,
CASE WHEN v.vendor_id IS NULL THEN 'not_matched' ELSE 'matched' END AS vendor_match_status
FROM (SELECT 1) s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM vendors
  WHERE tax_id = ($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'vendor_tax_id')
     OR lower(vendor_name) = lower($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'vendor_name')
     OR bank_account = ($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'bank_account')
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN tax_id = ($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'vendor_tax_id') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
  LIMIT 1
) v ON TRUE;

parameters.query:
SELECT $1::jsonb AS finance_payload,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.document_hash = ($1::jsonb->>'document_hash'))
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_number = ($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'invoice_number') AND i.total = NULLIF($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'total','')::numeric)
OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.vendor_id = NULLIF($1::jsonb->'vendor'->>'vendor_id','')::uuid AND i.invoice_number = ($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'invoice_number')) AS duplicate,
COALESCE((SELECT payment_status FROM invoices i WHERE i.invoice_number = ($1::jsonb->'invoice'->>'invoice_number') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1),'pending') AS existing_payment_status;

WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb x), saved AS (
INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_number,vendor_id,invoice_date,due_date,currency,subtotal,tax,total,purchase_order_number,status,validation_status,approval_status,payment_status,duplicate_flag,document_hash,confidence,raw_extraction,created_at,updated_at)
SELECT x->'invoice'->>'invoice_number', NULLIF(x->'vendor'->>'vendor_id','')::uuid, NULLIF(x->'invoice'->>'invoice_date','')::date, NULLIF(x->'invoice'->>'due_date','')::date, x->'invoice'->>'currency', NULLIF(x->'invoice'->>'subtotal','')::numeric, NULLIF(x->'invoice'->>'tax','')::numeric, NULLIF(x->'invoice'->>'total','')::numeric, x->'invoice'->>'purchase_order_number', x->'decision'->>'status', x->'decision'->>'validation_status', x->'decision'->>'approval_status', CASE WHEN x->'decision'->>'action' = 'auto_process' THEN 'approved' ELSE 'pending' END, COALESCE((x->>'duplicate')::boolean,false), x->>'document_hash', NULLIF(x->'invoice'->>'confidence','')::numeric, x->'invoice', now(), now() FROM p
ON CONFLICT (document_hash) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now()
RETURNING * )
SELECT saved.id AS invoice_id, saved.invoice_number, saved.status, saved.approval_status, saved.payment_status, p.x AS finance_payload FROM saved,p;
